questionnaire.title: LORILLARD TOBACCO COMPANY CALIFORNIA LOBBYIST EMPLOYER REPORT
questionnaire.instructions: Please read this questionnaire thoroughly and complete all sections fully. The lobbying laws in California place the burden of scrutiny, through the audit process, on lobby employers rather than the lobbyists themselves.

partI.title: Filers Specific Lobbying Interests
partI.description: We will indicate the lobbying activities which we have undertaken on your behalf.

sectionA.title: Lobbyist Employment Status
sectionA.description: It is our understanding that you do not have a registered California lobbyist who is an employee of your company.
